about:
Precision Racing Components LLC is based in Indianapolis, Indiana. The company is led by President Chris Sumner. A founding year is not publicly disclosed, and ownership details have not been specified.

The company designs and manufactures dry sump oil pumps and complete oil system solutions for motorsports applications. Its product line includes sprint car oil pumps, late model oil pumps, pulley drive oil pumps, and sump mounted oil pumps. Precision machining capabilities support the production of engine accessory kits, though facility size, headcount, and annual volumes are not published.

Precision Racing Components serves championship winning race teams and manufacturers worldwide. Its customer base spans professional motorsports series and automotive manufacturers seeking custom oil system packaging and performance.

The company emphasizes a passion for excellence and decades of experience, aiming to help customers win races and championships. It holds ISO 9001:2015 certification and works closely with clients to tailor oil systems to specific performance and packaging requirements.
